name: Ondřej Kolář - Après le § 26 - Am 13
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text: 26a. Is worried that massive EU funding under various programmes and pre-accession aid risks fuelling the entrenched corruption; considers that public trust in the EU will only erode further when citizens see corrupt practices being rewarded with financial gains; calls for strict conditionality, full transparency and independent audit mechanisms to ensure that funds are wisely spent in the way they are meant to be and not misused for personal gain or diverted to politically motivated structures;
